# Bookbreaker

> A free sports-betting analysis app for Mac (Apple Silicon) and a command-line tool: it devigs every price four ways, stakes an arbitrage in round numbers, and shows what each number might be wrong by. No account, and your betting record never leaves your machine.

Bookbreaker is an analysis tool for adults 21 and over in states where sports betting is legal. It tells you what the numbers say; you place your own bets. It does not take bets, hold money or connect to any sportsbook account, never asks for a sportsbook login, and is not affiliated with any sportsbook. The Mac app makes three kinds of network call, all started by you: Check for updates, which asks bookbreaker.bet for the latest version; the Live prices switch, which reads Kalshi's and Polymarket US's public prices; and, with your own Odds API key, live sportsbook odds from api.the-odds-api.com. Otherwise you type prices, paste a betslip or import your book's CSV. An arbitrage profit is locked only if both bets are accepted and stand. Built by Matthew Kerr in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

## The app

- [Bookbreaker](https://bookbreaker.bet/): what it does, with every figure computed by the engine you download
- [Download](https://bookbreaker.bet/download/): the Mac app (Apple Silicon, M1 or later; signed and notarised by Apple) and the same engine as a command-line tool for macOS, Linux or Windows (pure Python, 3.9 or newer). Free, with published SHA-256 checksums
- [How it works](https://bookbreaker.bet/how-it-works/): the four devig methods side by side, what rounding an arbitrage stake costs, and how old a price already is
- [Account longevity](https://bookbreaker.bet/account-longevity/): why an account that gets limited stops earning, what the shape of a bet gives away, and what the tool refuses to do
- [What your betting record proves](https://bookbreaker.bet/what-your-record-proves/): a return with the interval around it, and why most records prove nothing

## Free calculators

- [All calculators](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/): each worked through on real prices, with the range the answer sits in; most take your own numbers and run the same engine in your browser
- [No-vig odds calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/no-vig-odds/): What are the true odds behind a sportsbook's price?
- [Expected value calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/expected-value/): Is this bet +EV?
- [Arbitrage calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/arbitrage/): How much do I stake on each side?
- [Kelly criterion calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/kelly/): How much should I bet?
- [Hold and vig calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/hold/): How much is this book charging me?
- [Bonus bet conversion calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/bonus-bet-conversion/): What is my free bet actually worth?
- [Middle calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/middle/): What does this middle need to hit to be worth it?
- [Odds converter](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/odds-converter/): American to decimal to implied probability
- [Break-even calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/breakeven/): What win rate does this price need?
- [CLV calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/closing-line-value/): Did I beat the closing line?
- [Hedge calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/hedge/): How much do I bet to lock in a profit?
- [Dutching calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/dutching/): How do I split a stake across several outcomes?
- [Parlay calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/parlay/): How much does a parlay really pay?
- [Deposit match calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/deposit-match/): Is a deposit match bonus worth it after rollover?
- [Effective bets calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/effective-bets/): How many bets am I really making if they are correlated?
- [Totals middle calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/totals-middle/): How do you price a totals middle bet?
- [No-sweat bet calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/no-sweat-bet/): What odds should I use for a no-sweat first bet?
- [Profit boost calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/profit-boost/): What is a profit boost actually worth?
- [Round robin calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/round-robin/): What does a round robin actually have to do to pay?
- [Poisson calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/poisson/): What are the scoreline and totals probabilities?
- [Low hold calculator](https://bookbreaker.bet/calculators/low-hold/): What does turning money over actually cost?

## Responsible gambling and terms

- [Responsible gambling](https://bookbreaker.bet/responsible-gambling/): for adults 21 and over where betting is legal. Help any time: call or text 1-800-MY-RESET (1-800-697-3738), or call 1-800-GAMBLER
- [Terms of use](https://bookbreaker.bet/terms/): a free analysis tool, not a sportsbook and not advice
- [Privacy](https://bookbreaker.bet/privacy/): the site counts visits without cookies, and the app sends nothing about you anywhere
